method: Overhead = first renderer surface above head height (Y > 2.0) on a 0.5 u grid inside the measured 1F enclosure, computed identically for the pre-build refresh audit and the final audit. Renderer-based on purpose: the kit ceilings are visual-only (no colliders), so the collider clearance audit (ground-continuity) cannot see them.
intentionallyOpen: GATE2 atrium, U+ glazed strip, escalator well (double height / level change); track-side strip V > -5 (not observed in any registered walk)
